reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and adds one shared isWeekendOrHoliday predicate used by every weekend check, rather than writing per-site holiday logic.

duplication.why: The day test and the move are shared, but the daily-skip filter stays in three places (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange), each now with its own ad-hoc look-ahead formula scaled by holidays.length.

placement.why: The predicate and move live in shared/schedules.ts, the field in RecurConfig, and parseRecurDate carries it into the rschedule data like the other weekend settings.

scope.why: Only threads the holidays field through the existing weekend paths and type.

maintainability.why: Weekend/holiday semantics are defined once, but every caller must remember to thread holidays into getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the three scaling heuristics (7*(n+1), 3+2n) are unexplained magic bounds.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in shared/schedules.ts decide what counts as a weekend/holiday day and where it moves; all of getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template use them, though each passes holidays explicitly and keeps its own daily-skip filter and look-ahead bound.
